mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( MIN(YEAR(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at))), YEAR(CURDATE()) ) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id

SELECT sales_date AS date, order_count AS orderCount, canceled_order_count AS canceledOrderCount, gross_sales_amount AS grossSalesAmount, canceled_amount AS canceledAmount, net_sales_amount AS totalAmount, average_order_amount AS avgAmount, cancel_rate AS cancelRate FROM vw_sales_daily WHERE sales_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY sales_date

SELECT sales_hour AS hour, COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(net_sales_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM vw_sales_hourly WHERE sales_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY sales_hour ORDER BY sales_hour

choose.when: SELECT sales_hour AS salesHour, sales_minute AS salesMinute, order_count AS orderCount, net_sales_amount AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE( ROUND(net_sales_amount / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 0), 0 ) AS averageOrderAmount FROM vw_sales_30min WHERE sales_date = #{salesDate} ORDER BY sales_hour, sales_minute
choose.otherwise: SELECT sales_hour AS salesHour, 0 AS salesMinute, SUM(order_count) AS orderCount, SUM(net_sales_amount) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE( ROUND( SUM(net_sales_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0), 0 ), 0 ) AS averageOrderAmount FROM vw_sales_30min WHERE sales_date = #{salesDate} GROUP BY sales_hour ORDER BY sales_hour

mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(month, 2, '0')) AS month, total_orders AS orderCount, total_sales AS totalAmount, average_order_amount AS avgAmount, canceled_orders AS canceledOrders, gross_sales_amount AS grossSalesAmount, canceled_amount AS canceledAmount, cancel_rate AS cancelRate FROM vw_sales_monthly WHERE year = #{year} ORDER BY year, month

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(sales_amount) DESC, menu_id ) AS `rank`, menu_id AS menuId, menu_name AS menuName, SUM(order_count) AS orderCount, SUM(sales_amount) AS salesAmount FROM vw_top_menu_daily WHERE sales_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY menu_id, menu_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, menuId LIMIT 4

SELECT payment_method_name AS label, ROUND( COUNT(*) / NULLIF( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vw_order_summary WHERE paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND payment_status_code NOT IN('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') ), 0 ) * 100, 2 ) AS percent FROM vw_order_summary WHERE paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND payment_status_code NOT IN('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') GROUP BY payment_method_name ORDER BY percent DESC, label

SELECT order_type_name AS label, ROUND( SUM(order_count) / NULLIF( ( SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM vw_order_status_summary WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status_code != 'CANCELED' ), 0 ) * 100, 2 ) AS percent FROM vw_order_status_summary WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status_code != 'CANCELED' GROUP BY order_type_name ORDER BY percent DESC, label

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{today} THEN net_sales_amount END ), 0 ) AS netSalesAmount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{today} THEN order_count END ), 0 ) AS orderCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{today} THEN average_order_amount END ), 0 ) AS averageOrderAmount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{yesterday} THEN net_sales_amount END ), 0 ) AS prevNetSalesAmount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{yesterday} THEN order_count END ), 0 ) AS prevOrderCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sales_date = #{yesterday} THEN average_order_amount END ), 0 ) AS prevAverageOrderAmount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o2 JOIN common_code st2 ON st2.id = o2.status_id WHERE st2.code IN ('RECEIVED', 'PREPARING') AND DATE(o2.created_at) = #{today} ) AS activeOrderCount FROM ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) AS sales_date, COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND os.code <> 'CANCELED' AND ps.code NOT IN('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.id END ) AS order_count, ( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) - COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND ( os.code = 'CANCELED' OR ps.code IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') ) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ) AS net_sales_amount, ROUND( ( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) - COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND ( os.code = 'CANCELED' OR ps.code IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') ) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ) / NULLIF( COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND os.code <> 'CANCELED' AND ps.code NOT IN('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.id END ), 0 ), 0 ) AS average_order_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id LEFT JOIN common_code os ON os.id = o.status_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(#{yesterday}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) IN (#{today}, #{yesterday}) GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) ) daily

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, ot.code AS orderType, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi3 WHERE oi3.order_id = o.id ) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ( SELECT m.name FROM order_item oi4 JOIN menu m ON m.id = oi4.menu_id WHERE oi4.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi4.id LIMIT 1 ), ' 외 ', ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi5 WHERE oi5.order_id = o.id ) - 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT m.name FROM order_item oi6 JOIN menu m ON m.id = oi6.menu_id WHERE oi6.order_id = o.id ORDER BY oi6.id LIMIT 1 ) END AS menuSummary, o.total_price AS totalAmount, st.code AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%H:%i') AS createdAtLabel FROM orders o JOIN common_code ot ON ot.id = o.order_type_id JOIN common_code st ON st.id = o.status_id WHERE DATE(o.created_at) = #{today} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT status_name AS label, SUM(order_count) AS count, CASE status_code WHEN 'PREPARING' THEN 'preparing' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'complete' WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'waiting' END AS tone FROM vw_order_status_summary WHERE order_date = #{date} GROUP BY status_code, status_name ORDER BY status_code

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN order_type_code = 'EAT_IN' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS eatIn, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN order_type_code = 'TAKE_OUT' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS takeOut FROM vw_order_status_summary WHERE order_date = #{date}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE sold_out = 1 ) AS menuSoldOut, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ing WHERE sold_out = 1 ) AS ingredientSoldOut, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opt_item WHERE sold_out = 1 ) AS optionSoldOut

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sales_date, '%d일') AS label, net_sales_amount AS amount, sales_date = #{endDate} AS isCurrent FROM ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) AS sales_date, ( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) - COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND ( os.code = 'CANCELED' OR ps.code IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') ) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ) AS net_sales_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id LEFT JOIN common_code os ON os.id = o.status_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) ) daily ORDER BY sales_date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_sales_amount), 0) AS netSales, COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS orderCount FROM ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND os.code <> 'CANCELED' AND ps.code NOT IN('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') THEN o.id END ) AS order_count, ( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) - COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND ( os.code = 'CANCELED' OR ps.code IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') ) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) ) AS net_sales_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id LEFT JOIN common_code os ON os.id = o.status_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(p.paid_at, o.created_at)) ) daily
